title: GitHub Copilot Skill Format
description: JSON Schema for GitHub Copilot agent skills (.github/skills/*/SKILL.md)

name.description: Unique identifier for the skill. Must be lowercase, using hyphens for spaces.

description.description: Description of what the skill does and when to use it. Be specific about both capabilities and use cases.

content.description: Markdown body with detailed instructions, procedures, examples, and references to bundled resources.

frontmatter.name: webapp-testing
frontmatter.description: Guides testing of web applications using browser automation and testing frameworks

examples.content:
# Web Application Testing

This skill helps you test web applications effectively.

## Procedures

1. Set up testing environment
2. Write unit tests
3. Run integration tests

## Resources

- [Test template](./test-template.ts)
